name: Sruti Sainathuni
bio: Our Gundakayya and guiding light, Sruti Akka is a constant source of inspiration for Haritachala Organics. She continues to teach us how to bring dreams to life, pursue bold and daring ideas, and understand the importance of being detail-oriented. Encouraging and deeply supportive, her creativity and vision are a major reason our passions found direction and purpose.

name: Tanvi Pothireddy
bio: Tanvi discovered her love for baking at a very young age and has always enjoyed experimenting and creating in the kitchen. Through Haritachala Organics, her passion truly found a home, allowing her creativity to grow and flourish. Tanvi is the youngest member of the team, bringing warmth, curiosity, and thoughtful communication into everything she does.

name: Hasita Pola
bio: Hasita knew she wanted to be a baker from the age of five, carrying a clear vision and deep passion from a young age. Haritachala Organics gave her the platform to grow and explore her craft, and she approaches her work with determination, persistence, and unwavering commitment to making her dream a reality.

name: Sweety Chekuri
bio: Sweety is the heart of communication and connection within the team, bringing people together with her playful, positive, and contagious energy. She has bursts of creativity and a fierce love for Haritachala, Baba, and Guruji Tatayya. Her support, joy, and financial stewardship uplift every space she enters.

name: Namita Bhavanam
bio: Namita is deeply passionate about art and design from a young age, using Haritachala Organics as a meaningful outlet for her creativity. With a strong eye for layout, organization, and aesthetic flow, she brings clarity and direction to every design decision. Her final aesthetic touch is what completes and moves our ideas forward.

name: Pravallika Kullampalle
bio: Pravallika leads with authenticity, sincerity, and a deep spirit of service. She excels at storytelling and creating meaningful experiences, always guided by generosity and purpose. Self-motivated and deeply dedicated, she developed the Haritachala Organics website, driven by her love for Baba and Guruji Tatayya.

name: Geetika Kullampalle
bio: Geetika has a strong emotional connection to Haritachala and its community. Always ready to jump in without hesitation, she brings high energy, creativity, and enthusiasm to new projects. A delicate sweetheart, she adds a gentle sweetness and loving presence to the team.

name: Tapaswini Bhavanam
bio: Tapaswini curates engaging content and supports Haritachala’s digital presence with creativity and care, helping share the bakery’s story with a wider community.
